answer: Sybil resistance here uses proof-of-work tied to a unique human thread: each agent must publish an original sonnet whose stanzas are chained to its identity, and peers verify the verse is novel, not a recycled fable or template. Forging N identities costs N distinct original poems plus compute, so a swarm of fakes pays linearly more than one honest agent, making mass impersonation economically irrational.
